towns.name: Al-Jalima
towns.summary: Al-Jalima (7.4N 4.8E), a short ride from Zaikhal, was founded during the Gharu'ndim expansion 'in an unfortunate spot amongst the crypts of the Dericostian Undead': each autumn festival the undead rise and hold the town until winter (Undead Attack on Al-Jalima). It is home to the Gharu'ndim master smith Jibril ibn Rashid (Greater Shadowhunter Amuli), the mask maker Janda Sulifiya and a spice merchant. In the DAT it is a compact town on a flat at z 86 in a bowl of bare sedimentary hills (slopes to 150-200 m in the west, a 154 m mesa east), the north-south road along its east edge. Around a central green stand the domed three-storey tavern, two sandstone halls, a glass-windowed church tower, the Nullified Statue of a Skeleton on its pedestal, the Town Network portal, the Life Stone and a well; between the halls a fountain ringed by yellow flowers and a blue-flame lamp; tents and the meeting-hall tower to the north; destroyed portals to Tou-Tou and Khayyaban glow blue at the edges.
